blocks.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 240 132" font-family="serif" font-size="13" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.4" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-linecap="round"><polygon points="30.0,110.0 210.0,110.0 150.0,25.0"/><text x="20.0" y="116.0" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="middle" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">A</text><text x="220.0" y="116.0" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="middle" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">B</text><text x="152.0" y="14.0" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="middle" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">C</text><text x="120.0" y="124.0" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="middle" fill="currentColor" stroke="none" font-style="italic">c</text><text x="188.0" y="64.0" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="middle" fill="currentColor" stroke="none" font-style="italic">a</text><text x="80.0" y="62.0" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="middle" fill="currentColor" stroke="none" font-style="italic">b</text></svg>
blocks.caption: In any triangle $ABC$: sine rule $\dfrac{a}{\sin A} = \dfrac{b}{\sin B} = \dfrac{c}{\sin C}$; cosine rule $a^2 = b^2 + c^2 - 2bc\cos A$; area of triangle $= \frac{1}{2}ab\sin C$
